products.title: OROS THE INVENTOR BROWN
products.body_html:
Eau De Parfum 85ml

The Inventor takes us back to the era of Ancient Egypt which marked the root of today’s creations.

The two distinct versions of The Inventor represent the 2 heads of the ancient Egyptian Mythology of Aker. Aker appears as a pair of twin lions, one named Duaj and the other Sefer, symbolizing yesterday and tomorrow.

Royal and virile, fierce and mighty, the lion conveyed many meanings to the ancient Egyptians.

The Inventor pays homage to the beauty of that Era and brings its mystery and beautiful architecture to the modern day.

 

The fragrance opens with very fresh notes  of Citrus accords paired up with Pink  Pepper and continues to a sensual blend  of spices like Bay leaves, Ginger and  Cedar, with Jasmine adding edge to the  fragrance. The base notes, uses a very  unique mix of Guaiac Wood, Patchouli  and Sandalwood making the fragrance  long-lasting.

Top notes:

Citrus accords, Pink pepper

Heart notes:

Bay leaves, Jasmine, Ginger, Cedar 

Base notes:

Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Sandalwood
